title: DNase I Treatment of Purified RNA in Solution for ISOLATE II Biofluids RNA Kit
author: Bioline
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.f5jbq4n
materials: Gently swirl tube to mix solution.

steps.title: Prepare DNase I reaction
steps.instruction: In a microcentrifuge tube combine 2.5 µL supplied DNase I solution, 10 µL DNase I Reaction Buffer DRB, and up to 87.5 µL eluted RNA; if the RNA volume is lower, add RNase‑free water to bring the total volume to 100 µL.

steps.title: Brief spin down
steps.instruction: Gently spin the tube for about 1 second at 1,000 × g to collect the mixture at the bottom.

steps.title: Incubate at room temperature
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction at room temperature (18‑25 °C) for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation clean‑up
steps.instruction: Purify the RNA by ethanol precipitation using the following sub‑steps:

substeps.instruction: Add 1/10 volume of 3 M sodium acetate (pH 5.2) to the reaction.
Add 2.5‑3 volumes of 96‑100 % ethanol (to a final volume of one part sample) and mix thoroughly.
Incubate at –20 °C for 1 hour (or overnight); use longer incubation for low‑concentration RNA and shorter for high‑concentration RNA.
Centrifuge at maximum speed for 10 minutes.
Wash the RNA pellet with ice‑cold 70 % ethanol.
Air‑dry the pellet and resuspend the RNA in RNase‑free water.
